request: can you make a really simple counter? just a button that adds one and shows the count, and i want the number saved so it's still there when i come back
design_rationale: A counter is glanced at and tapped, so one centred card with a big tabular number and a single primary button; neutral base with a green accent, Outfit for friendly digits and nova's clean density.

verify.steps: Open the counter, see Count: 0, click Add one twice, see Count: 2, reload and still see Count: 2.

why.services/counter.jac: Tally node holding the number; get_count reads it and add_one adds 1, both creating the node under root on first use.
why.components/CounterScreen.jac: The whole screen: the Counter heading, Count: N with a loading state, and the Add one button.
why.main.jac: Registers the counter endpoints, loads global.css and renders the counter screen.

write_reasoning.services/counter.jac: Backend first: one Tally node under root, created on first use by a private _tally helper. add_one returns the new value so the client never re-reads through the cached get_count.
write_reasoning.components/CounterScreen.jac: get_count is awaited once in async can with entry, and handle_add is async because it awaits add_one. The count is set from the value add_one returns, since a def:pub read is cached and would come back stale.
write_reasoning.main.jac: Last, main.jac: it imports get_count and add_one from services.counter with no leading dot so both endpoints are registered on the server, then renders the screen; one screen needs no router.

plan_call_reasoning: Plan the build: one screen with one saved number, so a single component and a tiny server.
plan_reasoning: One screen: a heading, the current count and an Add one button. The number lives on one node under root behind two def:pub functions; the client loads it on mount and takes the new value from add_one. main.jac last.
plan_summary: Build plan written to .jaccoder/build_plan.json: a single-screen counter, 4 files leaf-first, the value on one server node via get_count and add_one, nova/neutral/green/outfit.
journal:
# Agent journal

## Issues
- A def:pub read is cached on the client on jac 0.34.28, so get_count is called only on mount and the screen shows the value add_one returns.

## Learnings
- One node under root, found with [root-->][?:Tally] and created on first use, is enough to keep a single value across reloads.
- The mount effect assigns the awaited value through a local before setting state.

## Last Action
Built Counter: a heading, Count: N loaded from the server on open, and an Add one button that saves each click. The preview renders and two clicks show Count: 2, still there after a reload.
final:
Counter is running: it shows the saved count when you open it, and each click on Add one adds 1 on the server. I clicked it twice, saw Count: 2, reloaded and it was still 2.

**Next steps**
- Add a Reset button
- Add a Subtract one button
- Keep separate counters with names
